question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. protectionism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the history and development of globalisation.
 
• It mentions the impact of the Industrial Revolution on trade across borders.
 
• According to the Peterson Institute for International Economics (PIIE), globalisation faced a downturn after World War I.
 
• Nations moved toward protectionism, implementing import taxes to protect their industries, which is why 'protectionism' is the correct fill for blank number 5.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Integration** refers to the process of combining or coordinating separate groups or elements into a unified whole.
 
• **Liberalisation** involves the removal of trade barriers and restrictions to encourage free trade among nations.
 
• **Diversification** is a strategy that involves entering into new markets or industries to reduce reliance on a single market or technology.
